scientific_integrity: The finite sharp norm and the infinite little-Lipschitz norm are proved analytically. Exact-rational enumeration independently checks small finite instances but does not certify infinite dimensions. The signed L-infinity Haar row identity is an acknowledged prior ingredient; historical priority is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform real binary Haar systems with depth-only ultrametric radii; sign multipliers only; infinite theorem concerns the little-Lipschitz norm closure of cylinder functions. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact Haar sign-unconditionality constants on binary ultrametric Lipschitz spaces
